cards.public_summary: Rico Dowdle joined Pittsburgh on a two-year, $12.25 million contract after Kenneth Gainwell left in free agency.
cards.evidence: After 2025 team MVP Kenneth Gainwell inked a two-year, $14 million deal with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in free agency, Pittsburgh pivoted and brought in Rico Dowdle on a two-year, $12.25 million contract.
cards.commentary: Dowdle's move to Pittsburgh puts him in a new backfield to monitor, but this report does not establish his depth-chart spot or expected workload.
cards.author: Jack Markowski
